english.text: They were not a handsome family; they were not well dressed; their shoes were far from being water-proof; their clothes were scanty; and Peter might have known, and very likely did, the inside of a pawnbroker's. author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Mama and cousin Eve often wax nostalgic about Roman Catholicism, evident when we have pasta meals at home. They are both converts to Protestantism. My late father Frank (or Jun) was the pioneer in my extended family, largely Roman Catholic, for conversion. Also, my paternal grandmother Lydia followed. My maternal grandfather Macario was already a Protestant of the United Church of Christ. He read literature from Baptists under Papa's influence. My Roman Catholic maternal grandmother Bebe was happy-go-lucky and couldn't care less about these things. My paternal grandfather Pito (Francisco) listened to Papa's witnessing and was proselytized to even at the death bed, when he died in his seventies.

english.text: The Dictionary contains a copious all-purpose vocabulary of about 27.000 international words and includes an Introduction with a detailed analysis of the methods employed in gathering and standardizing so comprehensive a body of terms which owe their representation in a variety of national languages to the fact that, with regard to considerable portions of their vocabularies, the languages of Western civilisation may be viewed as so many variants or dialects of a common standard.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Everybody has his or her own idiolect of each language that he or she knows. My own English idiolect is weird for some. In speaking, I choose a variety of accents, depending on the listener. When I speak English to Filipinos, I try to use a more Filipino-accented English, because it is easier for them to understand. When I speak to a Canadian or American, I shift to a more North American accent. In writing, I learned the American way until age 10 in the Philippines. From age 10 and above in Canada, I learned Canadian English writing, up to university level. My appetite for science fiction and fantasy books from both American and British authors has affected my writing style. Some Cantonese opine that my writing is British, and it reminds them of England. My philosophy is that English is an international language and its origin can be divorced from its essence, as the case, I think, also of Spanish and French. Ergo, I urge Cantonese to divorce the essence of English from its land of origin. My favourite English writers are the British sci-fi author Olaf Stapledon and the American inventor-philosopher Buckminster Fuller.

text: 每個人都有佢自己識嘅每種語言嘅白痴語言。我自己嘅英文白痴對一啲人嚟講係好奇怪。喺講嘢嘅時候，我會揀唔同嘅口音，視乎聽眾而定。當我同菲律賓人講英文嘅時候，我會嘗試用比較有菲律賓口音嘅英文，因為佢哋會比較容易理解。當我同一個加拿大人或者美國人講嘢嗰陣，我會用一種比較北美嘅口音。喺寫作方面，我喺菲律賓學咗美國嘅方式，直到10歲。由10歲以上喺加拿大，我學咗加拿大嘅英文寫作，直到大學水平，我對美國同英國作家嘅科幻同奇幻書嘅興趣影響咗我嘅寫作風格，有啲廣東話嘅人認為我嘅寫作係英國嘅，而呢個令佢哋諗起英國，我嘅理念係英文係一種國際語言，而佢嘅起源可以同佢嘅本質分離，我覺得，我覺得，英文同法文嘅起源。我最鍾意嘅英文作家係英國科幻作家奧拉夫 · 斯泰普爾頓同美國發明家哲學家巴克明斯特 · 富勒。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the 25th of April of 2025, I had several walking excursions to Tim Hortons café to enjoy various drinks and goodies. It was my fourth hanami—cherry-blossom viewing—at St. Albans Road. Four days in a row, it has been. The pink petals are starting to fade. I ventured into the nearby Roman Catholic church, the big new one which replaced the older one there. In the older one, there were places near the entrances for holy statues and a Mexican mural—as Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe. I did not have a chance to take a photograph of it when it was there. The new church is too modern for my taste. In any case, my religion now is Syncretic, tending towards Buddhism-Animism. In my childhood, I was nominally a Roman Catholic.

text: 喺2025年4月25號，我有幾次步行遊覽 Tim Hortons 咖啡館，享用唔同嘅飲品同好物。呢個係我第四次喺聖阿爾本斯道觀賞花見 — 櫻花觀賞。連續四日，都係咁。粉紅色嘅花瓣開始褪色。我冒險入咗附近嘅羅馬天主教教堂，嗰間新嘅大教堂取代咗嗰度舊嗰間。喺舊嗰幅入面，入口附近有啲地方可以放聖像同一幅墨西哥壁畫 — — 叫做瓜達盧佩女神。當佢喺嗰度嘅時候，我冇機會影到佢。新教堂太現代，唔啱我口味。無論點樣，我而家嘅宗教係合體，傾向於佛教 - 動物主義。我細個嗰陣，我名義上係一個羅馬天主教徒。
